description: Source code for a watchdog timer driver implementation for Zephyr RTOS, specifically for Nordic Semiconductor hardware. It manages watchdog timer setup, disabling, timeout installation, feeding, and alarm callbacks.

methods.name: wdt_counter_setup
methods.description: Configures the watchdog counter, starts the counter if options are supported.

methods.name: counter_alarm_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the counter alarm triggers; stops the counter, calls user callback, and may reboot if reset flag is set.

methods.name: timeout_set
methods.description: Sets or cancels a counter alarm for a specific channel.

methods.name: wdt_counter_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration for the watchdog, validating parameters and reserving a channel.

methods.name: wdt_counter_feed
methods.description: Feeds (resets) the watchdog timer for a specific channel.

methods.name: wdt_counter_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog counter device, setting the number of channels.
